notes: New in Work and Create: Redesign my PowerPoint. Upload your deck and get it back with a modern design, using the same content
The redesign checks every number and limit against your original, keeps your pictures and speaker notes, and uses your airline template if you've added one
All decks get richer layouts: section dividers, two columns, key figures, WARNING/CAUTION/NOTE and memory-item boxes, styled tables and big-picture slides, with slide numbers
